brief: The finished audio link cable: a short crossed audio adapter cable: grey round cable with a round silver five-pin DIN plug at one end; at the other end the cable splits into two short wires, one red and one white, that cross over each other; their ends run into a small chunky black bakelite two-pole connector block, and the wires between the cable and the connector are fully covered by a beige braided cloth insulation sleeve with thin dark-blue threads.
